# Reverend Jo

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c19 P13](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0013)</sub>
- **Role:** Minister  <sub>[v3 c19 P13](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0013), [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jo  <sub>[v3 c24 P8](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0008), [v3 c24 P13](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0013), [v3 c27 P31](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0031)</sub>; Jonas  <sub>[v3 c24 P8](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0008)</sub>; Reverend Jo  <sub>[v3 c19 P13](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0013), [v4 c3 P9](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0009)</sub>

## Appearance

He is an ugly young man with a large, loose-jointed figure and very long legs. He has lank tow-colored hair, green eyes, a large mouth, and very large ears. When preaching, he exhibits an intellectual brow and inspired eyes.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)_

## Personality

He has a lovely voice and an earnest, gentle, and tender disposition. He possesses a great deal of humor, enjoying jokes and laughter, but is deeply devoted to his religious calling.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P20](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0020), [v3 c27 P14](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0014)_

## Traits

- Earnest and tender  <sub>[v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)</sub>
- Good-tempered  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>
- Earnest and devoted to his work  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c24 P20](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0020)</sub>

## Abilities

- Preaching eloquent and inspiring sermons  <sub>[v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)</sub>
- Possesses a charming and lovely speaking voice  <sub>[v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011)</sub>

## Goals

- To serve as a minister and work in the slums  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>

## History

Jonas Blake attended Redmond College and St. Columbia. During one summer, he took charge of the Prospect Point Mission Church where he met Philippa Gordon. Though he initially resisted becoming a minister, he accepted it as his calling and dedicated himself to his work. After graduating, he took charge of a mission church on Patterson Street in the slums. He eventually married Philippa Gordon, with the couple going on a tour through the land of Evangeline before settling on Patterson Street.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P8](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0008), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c27 P31](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0031), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 c39 P40](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0040)_

## Background by volume

- Graduated from St. Columbia and studied at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c24 P8](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0008), [v3 c27 P31](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0031)</sub>
- Spent a summer in charge of the Prospect Point Mission Church  <sub>[v3 c24 P8](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0008)</sub>

## Quotes

> I tried to be something else for a long time—I didn’t want to be a minister. But I came to see at last that it was the work given me to do—and God helping me, I shall try to do it.  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>
